game_name: The King of Fighters '98 - The Slugfest / King of Fighters '98 - Dream Match Never Ends (NGM-2420, alt board)
general_issues: Select kof98a.zip. Keep parent archives and neogeo.zip beside it. Offline physical DIP switches are in Game Settings. Use Test Menu for the original game soft-DIP options. TPO assigns all players and cabinet switches automatically. Up to 2 computers.
